# Amazon

> > Amazon's global ecosystem spanning e-commerce, AWS cloud services, advertising, developer platforms (Alexa, Fire TV, Ring), Whole Foods Market, and Amazon Luna gaming.

Amazon.com serves as the hub for Amazon's consumer marketplace, AWS (Amazon Web Services) cloud infrastructure, advertising solutions, and developer tools. The platform integrates modern authentication (OpenID, WebAuthn, passkey support) across services including Kindle, Prime, and seller tools.

## Key Topics

- AWS (Amazon Web Services)
- Amazon EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud)
- AWS CDK (Cloud Development Kit)
- Alexa & Amazon Devices
- Prime membership & delivery
- Whole Foods Market
- Amazon Ads & DSP
- Seller Central & fulfillment
- OpenID & WebAuthn authentication
- Passkey authentication
- Amazon Luna cloud gaming
- Kindle & reading services
- Fire TV & Ring platforms
- S3 storage & Lambda functions

## Getting Started with AWS

- [Getting Started - Cloud Computing Tutorials for Building on AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/getting-started): AWS fundamentals resource center with tutorials & cloud essentials
- [Hands-On Tutorials for Amazon Web Services (AWS)](https://aws.amazon.com/getting-started/hands-on): Step-by-step AWS hands-on tutorials for getting started with cloud
- [AWS Tutorials](https://aws.amazon.com/tutorials): AWS tutorials directory for single & multi-service use cases
- [Get started with Amazon EC2 - Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/EC2_GetStarted.html): Amazon EC2 getting started: launch, connect & manage instances tutorial
- [Tutorial: Create your first AWS CDK app - AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) v2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/hello-world.html): AWS CDK v2 hello world tutorial: Lambda function deployment via CLI

## Developer Platforms & Tools

- [Amazon Developers](https://developer.amazon.com): Developer portal for Alexa, Fire TV, Ring, Appstore & Vega OS platforms
- [Amazon Sign-In](https://xb-node-fe.amazon.com/glenn/home): Amazon authentication page with passkey & OpenID/WebAuthn support

## Selling on Amazon

- [How to sell on Amazon | Sell on Amazon](https://sell.amazon.com/sell): Beginner guide for Amazon sellers: account setup, listing & fulfillment

## Amazon Services & Products

- [Whole Foods Market: Shop Groceries & Weekly Sales](https://wfm.amazon.com): Whole Foods Market homepage featuring prepared meals & Prime delivery
- [Amazon Luna Cloud Gaming](https://gaming.amazon.com): Amazon Luna cloud gaming service (currently experiencing technical issues)
- [Amazon Sign-In](https://read.amazon.com): Kindle reading service authentication page with passkey support

## About Amazon

- [Our Origins](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/our-origins): AWS origin story from 2006 launch with S3 & EC2 by Matt Garman
- [About us: Discover our mission and brand values | Amazon Ads](https://advertising.amazon.com/about-us): Amazon Ads mission & values with DSP, CTV, Prime Video solutions

## Support & Help

- [Help and FAQ - Amazon Ads Academy](https://advertising.amazon.com/academy/help): Amazon Ads Academy FAQ covering certifications & account issues

## Optional

- [Go to website](https://amazon.com/gp/navigation-country): Country/region selector for Amazon websites across 20+ global markets
